reason: A separately frozen one-replication seed matrix permits direct count and random-start checks if the 32-replication native event log exposes only one replication, as observed for A08.var01 and A08.var02.
exact_seed_delta: From frozen aggregate A08.var03 input, set Control.NREPS 32 to 1, Control.RSEED to the seed number as a string, and ProblemDescription.PDESC to a seed-specific label. Every other row and table stays unchanged.
execution: One session-0 SSH batch holds the host-wide Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue mutex for all 32 seed runs and checks GUI PID 13340 before and after each native step.

Each seed has a unique immutable versioned subdirectory with copied input, import/export/calc/jsonreport logs and files, exact source-table roundtrip, per-step record, raw SHA-256 seals and an outer source-hash-before/after closure.
Any failed native command, missing output, changed source, altered GUI, missing seed, or roundtrip mismatch fails the batch; no partial matrix is published as accepted.
predeclared_acceptance: All 32 seeds convert with zero errors and classified warnings; each one-replication report has NREP=1 and 72 aligned half-hour bins.

For each seed, count logged mission starts and preserve timestamp/mission identity. Every start must lie in [8,20); count>1 requires distinct printed timestamps. Every started fixed-template mission must log success and completion two hours later. Reject shortage, delay, cancellation, failure, repair or stock demand.

Each seed's reported aircraft operation exposure must equal two hours times its realized count within report-bin rounding tolerance; terminal readiness must be eight aircraft. The observed counts must include at least two values and one count>=3 run must have non-equidistant start gaps.

Report the 32-seed count mean/variance and nominal two-sided 95 percent Student-t half-width, targeting at most one mission. Compute one mean start time per nonzero-count seed and a Student-t half-width across these seed means, targeting at most 1.5 hours; use the actual nonzero-seed degrees of freedom. Pooled event start times are descriptive only.

Compare seed 1's timeline with the aggregate log only as observed same-seed consistency. Do not treat the explicit RSEED runs as the aggregate's hidden replications or force their pooled mean to equal the aggregate averaged report.
A separate read-only reviewer replays manifest, generated source hashes, each raw closure, event/report ledgers and statistics without importing author validation.
limits: The 32 seeds form a fixed convenience matrix, not a random sample of seed values. Nominal Student-t inference presumes independent seed-level observations and cannot establish the generator's distribution or independence.
Zero quantity and high-count capacity outcomes remain unverified unless drawn. Other distributions, zero period, invalid combinations, GUI visuals and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
